blocks.text: Isla del Sol: calm water, sparse vegetation and reflections of the sky
La Paz, the Moon Valley, Tiwanaku and return to Lima

Buffet breakfast.

In the morning, take a sightseeing tour of La Paz, where ancient Andean traditions are still part of modern city life.

You will see historic squares and architectural landmarks, learn about local culture and visit the famous Witches' Market (Mercado de las Brujas). The market sells traditional medicinal plants, amulets, ritual objects and handicrafts that reflect Andean beliefs.

Next, visit the Moon Valley (Valle de la Luna) on the outskirts of the city. Unusual rock formations, deep gullies and pointed clay spires make the landscape look like the surface of another planet.

Then continue to Tiwanaku, one of South America's most important archaeological sites, about 70–75 kilometres from La Paz.

Tiwanaku was the centre of a powerful pre-Inca civilisation that helped shape Andean cultures. Monumental stone structures, ceremonial grounds and the famous Gateway of the Sun survive at the site. Archaeological finds show how much its ancient inhabitants knew about architecture and astronomy, and how they organised their society. Some of their traditions and achievements later influenced the Incas.

After the tour, transfer to the airport for your flight to Lima.

On arrival in the Peruvian capital, you will be met and taken to the 4-star Ikonik hotel or a hotel of the same category.
The itinerary ends with a flight from La Paz to Lima. The departure airport and whether the return flight is included are confirmed before you pay for the tour.
